quotes.text: Set up future payments with Kakao Pay
Learn how to save Kakao Pay to charge your customers later.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Make sure that you keep a record of your customer’s written agreement to these terms, and only submit charges in accordance with the agreed terms.
Your customer must authorize you to use their NICEPAY account for future payments through Stripe Checkout.
Recurring payments must be made with `capture_method: "automatic"`. Manual capture isn’t supported.
If you need to create a mandate, set [mandate_data](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/create.md#create_payment_intent-mandate_data).

findings: Attempt 3 retains initial full numbered read proof for all four unchanged SHA-256 pins from the accepted prior receipt; appended ranges record this reassigned worker's own targeted numbered reads. The attempt-2 receipt and targeted review plus all four pinned evidence files match their trusted attempt-3 hashes.

The November 7 raw establishes only the purpose, save Kakao Pay for later charges, and two parameterized Checkout and Direct API routes (new raw lines 5-14). It provides no active setup, mandate, currency, redirect, status, API-version, or capture rule. The diff is a full May-body-to-index capture change (diff lines 3-13, 579-580), not evidence of functional removal or newly verified November behavior.

The May 8 Checkout guide says Kakao Pay is unavailable in Singapore and requires customer permission/written terms for future offline charging, including transaction scope, frequency/timing, amount determination, and subscription cancellation policy (old raw lines 12-42). It distinguishes customer-configured Account with customer_account (Accounts v2, GA for Connect users and public preview for other users with preview version) from Customer/customer (v1) (old raw lines 44-87). This historical availability/version scope is missing from the mapped source's overview at source lines 11-19; it must not become an unqualified current eligibility claim.

May Checkout creates a server-side setup-mode Session with card and kakao_pay and either customer_account or customer, redirects to the Session URL, and asks the customer to authorize their NICEPAY account (old raw lines 90-141). The Direct API's SetupIntent path creates a server-side SetupIntent with kakao_pay, customer identity, and usage off_session or on_session, then confirms client-side via confirmKakaoPaySetup with a SetupIntent client secret, return_url, and online customer acceptance inferred from client (old raw lines 159-171, 212-260, 334-384). These are distinct UI paths and setup does not itself charge or prove authorization succeeded.

May Direct API later-payment path uses a separate PaymentIntent with a saved PaymentMethod, customer/customer_account and off_session true when the customer is outside checkout; recurring charges require capture_method automatic, with no manual capture (old raw lines 526-569). Detaching the reusable method is described with mandate.updated and payment_method.detached events (old raw lines 572-574). A browser return, Session creation, or saved method is not evidence of a successful future charge.

The old 'optional manual redirect' block uses a PaymentIntent with amount 1000 KRW, confirm true, and return_url, but no customer/customer_account, setup_future_usage, or mandate_data (old raw lines 386-444). It demonstrates redirect_to_url handling for a payment, not a complete save-for-future setup path. Source lines 37-39 currently list it as a save path; qualify or relocate it to avoid a false answer to how to save Kakao Pay. The distinct later setup_future_usage PaymentIntent path explicitly adds customer, off_session saving intention, and optional mandate_data (old raw lines 446-521; source lines 33-35).

The May PaymentIntent setup_future_usage samples use currency ngn in both Accounts v2 and Customers v1 examples (old raw lines 473-492, 502-521), while the same guide uses krw for its other PaymentIntent examples (old raw lines 399-408, 539-569), and the existing Korean-method concept states KRW only (wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 24-30). The source and concept already warn about the copy mismatch (source lines 49-52; concept lines 81-88); retain the warning and do not infer NGN Kakao Pay support from code.

The May guide has a SetupIntent client-secret paragraph that calls it part of a PaymentIntent (old raw lines 263-265) and a final Checkout testing paragraph that tells users to click Pay and describes PaymentIntent requires_action/succeeded/requires_payment_method even though the Checkout branch is setup mode (old raw lines 90-141, 576-578). Keep these old documentation inconsistencies out of a confirmed SetupIntent outcome claim; the November index does not resolve them (new raw lines 9-14).

The mapped source frontmatter omits canonical_url (source lines 1-9). That is a baseline provenance/schema correction: require canonical_url: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kakao-pay/set-up-future-payments, which exactly matches both pinned raw Source URL lines (old raw line 1; new raw line 1). Retain its May 8 date and raw reference and add the November 7 navigation capture separately; the field is not evidence of a new payment behavior.

The affected Korean-method concept states an Accounts v2 plus v1 Kakao Pay dual path without its dated availability condition (wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:81-85). Old raw lines 48-56 and 163-171 say customer-configured Accounts v2 was generally available to Connect users but public preview for other Stripe users, requiring a preview API version for preview participants. The source assessment must carry that scope and the concept needs the same reciprocal May-dated warning; the November index cannot establish universal Accounts v2 access.
substantive_changes: No substantive Kakao Pay saving or recurring-payment change is established by the November index (new raw lines 5-14). The needed source update is navigation/provenance plus correction of a pre-existing source categorization error: a manual redirect PaymentIntent without saving fields appears under save paths (source lines 37-39; old raw lines 386-444, 446-521).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain as May 8, 2026 evidence only: Singapore exclusion, written customer agreement, NICEPAY authorization, Accounts v2 customer-configured Account versus v1 Customer, Checkout setup Session, Direct API SetupIntent client confirmation and optional save-during-payment PaymentIntent path (old raw lines 12-42, 44-56, 90-141, 159-171, 212-260, 362-384, 446-521). November raw lines 9-14 give route selection only.

Retain the May later off-session PaymentIntent and automatic-capture-only recurring caveat, detach events, and sandbox testing as path- and environment-qualified claims (old raw lines 526-578). Preserve the currency ngn sample conflict and the old SetupIntent/PaymentIntent terminology and Checkout test text conflicts as warnings, not executable guarantees (old raw lines 263-265, 473-521, 576-578).
conflicts: Source lines 37-39 make the manual redirect PaymentIntent look like a save path, but its May example lacks customer, setup_future_usage, and mandate data (old raw lines 386-444); the actual save-during-payment PaymentIntent path is separately documented at old raw lines 446-521. Qualify the first as payment redirect only, not confirmed future-payment setup.

The old ngn setup_future_usage examples at old raw lines 473-521 conflict with old krw examples at lines 399-408 and 539-569 and concept KRW-only at wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 24-30; existing source lines 49-52 and concept lines 81-88 warn about this. Preserve reciprocal warning rather than treating examples as support evidence.

Old raw lines 263-265 misdescribe a SetupIntent client secret as from a PaymentIntent, and old raw lines 576-578 call the Checkout setup test a Pay/PaymentIntent test; both conflict with explicit Checkout setup and SetupIntent paths at old raw lines 90-141, 225-260, 362-384. Do not copy the mismatched identity/status wording into the source or concept.

Kakao Pay concept line 83 presents Accounts v2 plus v1 dual paths without the May guide's Connect-GA versus other-user public-preview and preview-version condition (old raw lines 48-56, 163-171). Qualify the concept and mapped source reciprocally; do not imply universal current availability from new raw lines 9-14.
unresolved_questions: The November variant links are not pinned as full pages, so current Checkout and Direct API steps, Accounts v2 availability, method eligibility, currency support, and post-redirect outcomes are unverified (new raw lines 11-14).

The old SetupIntent-versus-PaymentIntent client-secret and Checkout sandbox-test wording inconsistencies need separately pinned current route authority before executable or status-specific advice is given (old raw lines 263-265, 576-578).

findings: Add the November two-route index as a separate navigation raw while dating May behavior and preserving Checkout versus Direct API distinctions (new raw lines 9-14; source lines 4-7, 21-39).

Correct source lines 37-39 so the manual redirect PaymentIntent example is not presented as a complete save path; its May request lacks customer and setup_future_usage, unlike the separate save-during-payment path (old raw lines 386-444, 446-521).

Keep written permission/NICEPAY authorization and v2 versus v1 customer identities visible, with May eligibility/version scope: Singapore exclusion and Accounts v2 Connect GA versus other-user preview (old raw lines 12-56, 90-141; source lines 13-25).

Preserve automatic capture as a later recurring-PaymentIntent constraint, not a SetupIntent parameter, and keep currency ngn versus krw example warning reciprocal with wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md lines 24-30, 81-88 (old raw lines 473-569; source lines 19, 43, 49-52).

Add the missing canonical_url field to source frontmatter lines 1-9 using exactly https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kakao-pay/set-up-future-payments (old raw line 1; new raw line 1), while preserving May 8 raw/date and adding November 7 index provenance separately. This repairs baseline schema/provenance, not provider behavior.

Coordinate the same May-dated Accounts v2 access/version caveat in wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:83: Connect users GA, other Stripe users public preview, and a preview API version for preview participants (old raw lines 48-56, 163-171). The concept's unqualified dual-path wording is not current universal access evidence.
conflicts: The source's manual server-side redirect save-path placement at lines 37-39 overstates old raw lines 386-444; May setup_future_usage saving is a different PaymentIntent path at old raw lines 446-521. The old raw's SetupIntent secret and Checkout test labels misidentify intent/status at lines 263-265, 576-578; its ngn example conflict is already flagged in source lines 49-52 and concept lines 81-88.

Concept line 83's unqualified Accounts v2 dual path needs the same dated Connect GA/other-user preview/API-version condition as mapped source (old raw lines 48-56, 163-171); November raw lines 9-14 cannot resolve present-day access.
source_assessments.reason: The November raw is navigation only, but the existing source misclassifies a payment redirect as a future-saving route, lacks exact canonical_url provenance, and needs dated Accounts v2 scope plus clear SetupIntent, PaymentIntent, identity, and recurring capture boundaries.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kakao-pay/set-up-future-payments, the complete November capture establishes only the purpose of saving Kakao Pay for later charging and links to Checkout and Direct API variants (new raw lines 5-14). The May 8 guide requires customer permission and NICEPAY authorization, distinguishes a customer-configured Account on Accounts v2 from a Customer on v1, and shows a Checkout setup Session or server-created SetupIntent confirmed by client-side confirmKakaoPaySetup (old raw lines 31-56, 90-141, 159-171, 212-260, 362-384). In that dated May guide, Accounts v2 was generally available for Connect users but in public preview for other Stripe users, with a preview API version required for preview participants (old raw lines 48-56, 163-171); the November two-link index does not verify present-day Accounts v2 availability or make the Account route universal (new raw lines 9-14). A separate saved-method PaymentIntent can later charge off-session with automatic capture (old raw lines 526-569). source-stripe-kakao-pay-set-up-future-payments.md covers those paths and the ngn sample bug, but its manual redirect entry must be scoped to a payment example that lacks saving fields (source lines 37-52; old raw lines 386-444).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/kakao-pay/set-up-future-payments, the November page is a two-link navigation index, not a substantive replacement or renewed account-eligibility rule (new raw lines 9-14; diff lines 3-13, 579-580). source-stripe-kakao-pay-set-up-future-payments.md must add its missing canonical_url field with that exact trusted URL (source lines 1-9; old raw line 1; new raw line 1), retain the May 8 raw/date, and add November 7 navigation provenance separately. Preserve May-dated written agreement, NICEPAY authorization, SetupIntent client confirmation and later off-session PaymentIntent automatic capture (old raw lines 31-56, 90-141, 225-260, 362-384, 526-569). The source and wiki/concepts/stripe-korea-payment-methods.md:83 both need the reciprocal Accounts v2 caveat: GA for Connect users, public preview for other Stripe users, and a preview API version for preview participants (old raw lines 48-56, 163-171); the v1 Customer path remains distinct. Its manual redirect item is only a PaymentIntent redirect example without customer or setup_future_usage (source lines 37-39; old raw lines 386-444, 446-521). Keep the ngn-versus-krw warning reciprocal (old raw lines 473-521, 539-569; concept lines 24-30, 81-88). Old SetupIntent client-secret and Checkout Pay/PaymentIntent test wording are internally inconsistent (old raw lines 263-265, 576-578); no browser return or sample proves current eligibility, successful setup, or payment.
